data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Applier executes only after stale-syncs-<pass>.attested.json is present, updates label and/or property to authoritative value
- dd-3: Post-pass bridge-fsck stale-sync count drops to zero or to reviewer-acknowledged residual

Add apply subcommand to plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/stale_band.py. Accepts --pass <N>. First invokes gate logic (task-4) — exits non-zero without mutations if gate fails. For each manifest entry where needs_review=false: calls AcliClient.update_issue_labels() THEN AcliClient.update_issue_property() in that fixed order (crash-safe: partial apply detectable by next plan pass). Skips entries with needs_review=true. After all entries: runs enumerate_stale_anomalies() post-pass, asserts count==0 OR equals count of needs_review=true entries (reviewer-acknowledged residual). Writes bridge_state/bootstrap/stale-syncs-<pass>.applied.json with per-entry success/skip status.

## TDD Test Spec
Given valid attested manifest with 3 entries (2 normal, 1 needs_review=true), AcliClient stub recording call order; When apply --pass 001 invoked; Then for each non-review entry: update_issue_labels called BEFORE update_issue_property (fixed order); needs_review entry skipped; post-pass enumerate returns 1 residual; exit 0. Given no attested.json; Then exits non-zero, zero AcliClient mutation calls.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Implement stale_band.py apply subcommand: label-then-property update with post-pass fsck verification
